title: SEBI Lets NRIs and OCIs Complete KYC From Abroad Without an India Visit
court: Securities and Exchange Board of India
case_name: Securities and Exchange Board of India circular easing KYC for clients resident outside India
citation: SEBI circular dated 4 November 2026, effective 3 December 2026
card_summary: SEBI's circular dated 4 November 2026 lets NRIs, OCI cardholders and other individuals abroad complete KYC for a demat or trading account online, without being physically present in India, if they live in a country the FATF treats as compliant. In-person verification can now be done over video. The change takes effect 3 December 2026 and replaces SEBI's earlier geo-tagging relaxation of December 2025.
card_tip: An NRI or OCI client in a FATF-compliant country can open or re-KYC a demat account fully online by video verification from 3 December 2026, without flying to India.
verification_notes: Circular date (4 November 2026) and effective date (3 December 2026) confirmed across LiveLawBiz, Moneylife, Outlook Money and TaxGuru reports, consistent with the opening section of SEBI's own circular PDF. The FATF-compliant-country condition and the move to video in-person verification are corroborated by at least two of the secondary sources. The circular's precise internal reference number is omitted here since it was seen in only one source and could not be independently cross-checked against the full primary text in this run.
